Janice Evaluated

Oct 19, 2006 • Janice Cotcher

As part of a school evaluation, I was observed in two classes today. He didn’t have to but he gave all the teachers feedback after. It went well but I’m glad it is over. I had to fake instructions in my day book from the last two weeks (sometimes I forget to write down what we are doing in class even though I have it planned). But let’s just keep that between us.
General Comments:

  • I have excellent rapport with students
  • I am obviously passionate about the content that I teach and it is contagious (it can be treated with a mild antibiotic)
  • I have an excellent sense of humour
  • I am willing to admit that I am not perfect and I make mistakes but that does not make me a bad teacher. As I tell my students, I know these concepts inside and out but I am not immune to stupid mistakes.

He made some suggestions like using an overhead instead of the white board and how to deal with a certain student that feels the need to verbalize everything.

One more note about school: during my prep period I was talking to a student who explained to me that soon he will have to start driving his “winter car”. Winter car? Apparently he has a Jaguar and a BMW. He is 18 years old and these are HIS cars. That is disgusting.
